I_ACCESS.description: Users report trouble logging in or creating accounts, including errors after updates and access limitations in some locations.

I_BILLING.description: Users object to subscription costs and say free-tier restrictions, advertising, or premium features make the service feel poor value.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs or content, search problems, and recommendations that are too narrow or repetitive.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report difficulty saving downloads, maintaining downloaded libraries, or listening offline.

I_OTHER.description: Users express general dissatisfaction or intent to leave without identifying a specific product problem.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report songs failing to start, stopping unexpectedly, or other playback and app reliability problems.

I_SUPPORT.description: Users report difficulty reaching support or resolving service problems, including slow responses and limited remedies.

I_USABILITY.description: Users describe confusing or inconvenient controls, navigation, and interruptions such as ads or unwanted background playback.
